findings.function: claimTokens, fixMediatorBalance, relayTokens (both), relayTokensAndCall, onTokenTransfer, handle*/deployAndHandle* (111 loops)
findings.source: SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn / Address.functionCall (copy of the call data), abi.decode(returnData, (string)) in TokenReader, revert(errorMessage) in Address._verifyCallResult (solc 0.7.5 memory copies)
findings.issue: Every bytes/string copy of this solc 0.7 build is a word loop followed by a masked store of the last partial word (38 'while idx >= 32' loops and 73 'while idx < n' loops); the tail expression with floor32(max(31, n)) and 256** masks is unreadable, and the copied data (call data, revert message 'SafeERC20: low-level call failed') is visible only through it.
findings.rule: A loop that copies 32-byte words from s to t while idx >= 32 (or idx < n), followed by 'mem[t' + floor32(n)] = mem[s' + floor32(n)] & ~(256**(32 - n % 32) - 1) | mem[t' + floor32(n)] & (256**(32 - n % 32) - 1)', is the copy mem[t len n] = mem[s len n] (the tail keeps the bytes after t + n); print it as one copy line. P7, with the masked-tail variant.

findings.function: handleBridgedTokens and the other handle* functions, relayTokens (both), relayTokensAndCall, onTokenTransfer, fixMediatorBalance, deployAndHandleBridgedTokens*
findings.decompiled: stor0[sha3('totalExecutedPerDay', Bytes(20, ...), block.timestamp / (24 * 3600))]  |  stor0[sha3(mem[_22 + 32 len mem[_22]])]  |  _25 = sha3(sha3(mem[_22 + 32 len mem[_22]]), 0) ... stor0[sha3(mem[mem[64] + 32 len _21 - mem[64] + 174])] = _value + stor[_25]  |  mem[0] = sha3(mem[_198 + 32 len mem[_198]]) / stor0[concat(mem[0])] = mem[_109]  |  mem[mem[64]] = _197 - mem[64] + 90 (two lines after mem[64] = mem[64] + 62)
findings.issue: Eternal-storage keys built at the free-memory pointer are not resolved: the same uintStorage entry prints as a resolved key, as sha3 of a memory range, and as the raw slot stor[_25] with _25 = sha3(sha3(...), 0) in one function, and the dailyLimit / maxPerTx writes of _initializeTokenBridgeLimits (and interestImpl, mediatorBalance reads) go through 'stor0[concat(mem[0])]' (P4), so the variable written is visible only from scratch-memory writes above. Even '_197 - mem[64]' is not folded right after 'mem[64] = mem[64] + 62'.
findings.rule: Same root cause as P2: fold mem[64] to its last stored value while no store intervenes ('_197 - mem[64] + 90' is 28), read words written at base + constant through later range reads, so sha3(mem[_x + 32 len mem[_x]]) becomes sha3('dailyLimit', Bytes(20, token)); 'stor[sha3(k, n)]' is the mapping access storN[k], and 'storN[concat(mem[0])]' with mem[0] = k, mem[32] = N is storN[k].

findings.decompiled: call bridgeContract.requireToPassMessage(...) with: args mediatorContractOnOtherSide, Array(len=36, data=Bytes(4, 0x0950d515), Bytes(28, _messageId >> 32), _messageId << 224), requestGasLimit
findings.source: BasicOmnibridge.sol requestFailedMessageFix: bytes memory data = abi.encodeWithSelector(this.fixFailedMessage.selector, _messageId); _passMessage(data, true)
findings.issue: The 36-byte message is printed by memory words, so the 32-byte _messageId after the 4-byte selector is split into its first 28 bytes and its last 4 bytes.
findings.rule: Adjacent slices 'Bytes(28, x >> 32), (x << 224)' covering 32 consecutive bytes are x: concatenate the data of an Array by byte ranges, not by words, so it prints 'Bytes(4, 0x0950d515), _messageId'.

findings.function: isTokenRegistered, isRegisteredAsNativeToken, set*Limit / set*PerTx, handle*, withinLimit (about 15 sites)
findings.source: TokensBridgeLimits.sol isTokenRegistered: return minPerTx(_token) > 0 (minPerTx returns limit for token 0, limit > 0 ? 1 : 0 otherwise); withinLimit: dailyLimit(address(0)) > 0
findings.issue: Both arms give the same result once compared with 0, yet the branch and an SSA copy are printed at each inlined site; 'dailyLimit' + address(0) prints as a 30-byte constant while the same key with a variable prints as sha3('dailyLimit', Bytes(20, token)).
findings.rule: (x > 0) > 0 is x > 0, so 'if c: v = x > 0 else: v = x; ... v > 0' is 'x > 0'; split a packed constant key at the same boundaries as the variable form ('dailyLimit', Bytes(20, 0)).

notes: Solc 0.7.5. The large functions (relayTokens x2, relayTokensAndCall, onTokenTransfer, deployAndHandleBridgedTokens(AndCall), fixMediatorBalance, handleNativeTokens(AndCall), fixFailedMessage, migrateTo_3_3_0) were reviewed by structure: owner / mediator / upgradeabilityOwner checks, the lock (stor6168) set and cleared around transferFrom, the balance-difference value, the token registration (_initializeTokenBridgeLimits writes and events), TokenReader name/symbol/decimals reads, the AMB requireToPassMessage call (P2 raw args), the _recordBridgeOperation writes and TokensBridgingInitiated; handleBridgedTokens, claimTokens and all small getters/setters were reviewed in full and are correct (claimNativeCoins' send with 'gas 2300 * (not value)' and the Sacrifice contract creation are right). The only explicit source loop is TokenReader.sol:88 (Yul for), shown readably at 20 inlined sites as 's = 0; t = data; while t: s = s + 1; t = 256 * t'. The other 111 whiles are compiler copies (P7). Selectors written as 4-byte slices print in decimal (2835717307, 2750734206). P8 is an estimate: nearly every eternal-storage key leaves its scratch writes (mem[0], mem[32], mem[128..]) in the text.
summary: Faithful and complete, but dominated by solc 0.7 copy loops with masked tails (111 P7) and by eternal-storage keys that print three different ways, including P4 writes whose target is only visible through scratch memory.
